description: Forty context-management cases for extraction, state updates, catalog resolution, deterministic decisions, and grounded responses. Cases 001 and 002 have manually reviewed expected results; the remaining generated expectations are drafts until reviewed.

comparison_rules.state_before: Merge this partial object over default_state. Nested objects replace the corresponding default value.
comparison_rules.extraction_patch: Only changed or explicitly reaffirmed fields are listed. Missing fields mean KEEP with null values.
comparison_rules.state_after_changes: Only fields expected to differ from state_before, or safety-critical fields expected to be cleared, are listed.
comparison_rules.natural_language: Do not grade exact response wording. Grade response_requirements and the typed engine action.
comparison_rules.manual_cases: manual_completion=true means a person manually reviewed the expected values.

test_cases.title: Manual: simple dental request

input.patient_utterance: I'm a new patient and I need a dental cleaning.

test_cases.notes: Complete this case manually. Start by identifying only the facts explicitly stated by the patient.
